title: The Real Reason You Can't Hear In Noisy Places
hook: Your brain actually filters out most of what you hear.

narration.text: Your brain actually filters out most of what you hear.
When there is background noise, your brain works harder.
It tries to separate speech from all the other sounds.
This takes a lot of mental effort and energy.
That is why you feel tired after a loud conversation.
It is also why you struggle to follow what is being said.
Comment if you have noticed this, like if it surprised you, and subscribe for more brain insights.

description: Ever wondered why it is so hard to hear someone in a noisy room? It is not just the volume. Your brain is working overtime to filter out the chaos and focus on speech, which can be exhausting.
topic: Why you sometimes struggle to hear what someone is saying when there is a lot of background noise. Your brain is trying to filter.
